text:
Since you ordered after 12 noon on Wednesday, your plant will ship the next Monday. Live plants only ship Monday–Wednesday.

After it ships, delivery takes the following time depending on your zone and shipping method:
- **Zone 1 (under 300 miles):** Standard 2–3 business days, Express next business day
- **Zone 2 (300–1,000 miles):** Standard 3–5 business days, Express 2 business days
- **Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote or island):** Standard 5–8 business days, Express not available

Also, if the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, your plant may be held up to 7 days, and we'd email you if that happens.
